sampling_scheme_theoretical_analysis.formal_assessment: Extending data collection until a fixed quota (N_def = 30) is reached is formally an inverse binomial / negative binomial sampling design over calendar sessions. The stopping time tau = min{t >= 252 : N_def(t) >= 30, t <= 504} is a stopping time adapted to the filtration of macro market regime signals F_{t-1}.
sampling_scheme_theoretical_analysis.bias_analysis: Because the extension rule is blinded to portfolio equity, returns, drawdowns, and shortfall metrics d_t, the stopping decision does NOT induce outcome-dependent optional stopping bias. Under the assumption of stationarity of defensive regime return distributions, sample mean d_bar remains an unbiased estimator of mu_d.
sampling_scheme_theoretical_analysis.finite_sample_caution: If the second year of sampling encounters a fundamentally different macroeconomic regime (e.g. higher interest rates or structural volatility shifts), combining sessions across years assumes distributional invariance.
